title: Andrologist visit
what: An andrologist is a doctor for men's health. They deal with erection problems, infertility, and hormones.
why: For problems with erections, when a couple cannot conceive for a long time, for pain in the scrotum, or low sex drive.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; tests take 1 to 7 days
tell_doctor: What exactly bothers you and for how long
What medicines and supplements you take
Long-term illnesses: diabetes, blood pressure, heart disease
Past surgery and injuries in the groin area
Results of past tests, if you have them

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down everything you want to ask ahead of time. It is easy to forget during the visit.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Take a regular shower the day before. No special prep is usually needed.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: If the doctor already ordered a semen analysis, you need to avoid ejaculation for a few days first. Ask the clinic how long.

bring: Results of past tests and ultrasounds
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms, health, and lifestyle
Sometimes the prostate is checked through the rectum
An ultrasound may be done right away
The doctor orders tests and explains the plan
feel: The exam is short and usually painless
Feeling awkward is normal. The doctor deals with these questions every day
after: Do the tests the doctor ordered
Come back when the results are ready
Only the doctor prescribes treatment, based on the results

faq.q: Do I really have to talk about these things with a doctor?
faq.a: Yes. Most problems can be solved if you talk about them. Everything you say is kept confidential.
Not necessarily. If the couple is planning a child, the doctor may invite both of you.

reminders.text: Andrologist visit tomorrow. Bring past tests and your list of medicines, and write down your questions.
